what_does_it_do: Provides an IP-friendly mechanism to carry time-sensitive information
For example: camera tally information, audio levels, control panel button presses and status
why_does_it_matter: ST 2110 does not provide an equivalent to GPI functionality
This leads to the danger of multiple proprietary approaches
how_does_it_work: Media Nodes emit and consume state and state change info
Lightweight messages sent using WebSockets or MQTT
